rows.abstract: \"The Public Assembly Act of 2005\". The bill requires that prior notice be given for the holding of a public assembly to the city/municipal mayor having jurisdiction over the venue. rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-11-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE INSURANCE BENEFITS OF BARANGAYS CAPTAINS AND OTHER BARANGAY OFFICIALS AND WORKERS
rows.abstract: The bill expands the insurance benefits of barangay officials, to wit: a) P100,000 death benefit benefit in case of death due to assassination or accident; b) 30,000 burial expense; and c) P50,000 reimbursement for actual hospitalization or medical expenses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2005-11-15

rows.author: E015
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING COMPUTER EDUCATION IN PUBLIC HIGH SCHOOLS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Computer Education Act\".
rows.abstract: \"Computer Education Act\". The bill mandates the inclusion of computer education in the curriculum of secondary public schools.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2005-11-15

rows.author: E015
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TRAVEL ALLOWANCES TO BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS. AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7883. OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS' BENEFITS AND INCENTIVES ACT OF 1995\" AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill grants barangay health workers transportation allowance of P500 monthly.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2005-11-15

rows.author: E046
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE IMPOUNDING OF MOTOR VEHICLES INVOLVED IN A VEHICULAR ACCIDENT THAT RESULTS IN THE DEATH OR SERIOUS PHYSICAL INJURY OF A PEDESTRIAN, COMMUTER OR BY-STANDER, UNLESS A CASH BOND IS POSTED
rows.title_short: Requiring the Impounding of Motor Vehicles Involved in a Vehicular Accident
rows.abstract: The bill calls for the impounding of any motor vehicle involved in a vehicular incident resulting in the death or serious physical injuries to a pedestrian, commuter or by-stander pending the outcome of any criminal/civil case unless a cash bond of not less than P50,000 is posted.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2006-01-18

rows.author: D077
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AS A CRIME THE ACT OF DRIVING ANY MOTOR VEHICLE WHILE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES AND/OR PROHIBITED DRUGS AND PROVIDING GRADUATED PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Defining as a Crime the Act of Driving Any Motor Vehicle While Under the Influence of Alcohol and/or Prohibited Drugs
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Drunk Driving Act of 2005\". The bill imposes the following penalties on drunk drivers (persons with blood alcohol concentration level of 0.6% or more): a) 1st offense - P1,000 fine and one year suspension of driver's license or 30 days imprisonment; b) 2nd offense - P5,000 fine and five years suspension of driver's license plus 30 days imprisonment; and c) 3rd offense - P10,000 fine and revocation of driver's license for five years plus 30 days imprisonment.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-05-29, transmitted to on 2006-05-31 and received by the Senate on 2006-05-31

second_reading.remarks: On April 05, 2006, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION (CHED),  AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7722, ENTITLED \"AN ACT CREATING THE COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES\"
rows.abstract: The bill proposes, among others, the creation of a multi-sectoral, interdisciplinary and collegial seven-member Board of Commissioners responsible for policy-making and governance of the entire high education subsystem.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2005-11-16

rows.author: C015
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A STUDENT LODGING PROGRAM THAT WILL RENDER AFFORDABLE, SAFE AND DECENT DORMITORIES OR BOARDING HOUSES TO UNDERPRIVILEGED STUDENTS
rows.title_short: “Student Lodging Act of 2005”
rows.abstract: “Student Lodging Act of 2005”.  The bill directs the National Housing Authority to grant loans to persons or corporations investing in student lodging or dormitory at affordable interest rates and reasonable payment schemes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2005-11-16

rows.author: D025
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR PROFESSIONAL PARAMEDICINE STANDARDS IN THE COUNTRY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure proposes to establish and develop standards of knowledge and skills in the practice of paramedicine and provides for their members’ certification and re-certification.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2005-11-21

rows.author: C067
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING A ONE-TIME AMNESTY ON CERTAIN TAX AND DUTY LIABILITIES, INCLUSIVE OF FINES, PENALTIES, INTERESTS AND OTHER ADDITIONS THERETO, INCURRED BY BUSINESS ENTERPRISES OPERATING WITHIN THE SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONES AND FREE-PORTS CREATED UNDER PROCLAMATION 420 SERIES OF 1994, PROCLAMATION 216 SERIES OF 1993, PROCLAMATION 984 SERIES OF 1997 AND EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 80 SERIES OF 1993, PURSUANT TO SECTION 15 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7227, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Declaring a One-Time Amnesty on Certain Tax and Duty Liabilities Incurred by Business Enterprises Operating Within the Special Economic Zones and Freeports
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant a tax amnesty on the deficiency taxes and duties, as well as the interest, surcharges, penalties and other additions thereto, incurred by certain investor-locators in special economic and free port zones created under RA 7227.
